run.summary:
Hey EHC fam! 🚀

Just wanted to take a sec to say how incredibly proud I am of all of us. We just took a level 9 planet, and honestly, that’s a massive flex. The coordination, the grind, the late nights — it all paid off.

And the cherry on top? I got awarded Prince! 🏆

This is what it looks like when a real guild comes together. Let’s keep this momentum going. On to the next one!

— Your boy, Prince of EHC 👑
